sentences.japanese: 闇はこれに打ち勝たなかった。
sentences.english: The darkness has not overcome it.

sentences.japanese: 闇の中でかろうじて２人の人影が見分けられた。
sentences.english: We could barely make out two figures in the dark.

sentences.japanese: 闇とは光がないことです。
sentences.english: Darkness is the absence of light.

sentences.japanese: 明かりが消えて、私たちは闇の中に取り残された。
sentences.english: The light went out and we were left in the dark.
